name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2026-04-09, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
